name: Orchard Sprint
description: Race the other orchards to fill your fruit crates before the harvest bell rings.

name: Tidepool
description: A two-player abstract duel about claiming shells as the tide slides in and out.

name: Pocket Dungeon
description: Delve a pocket-sized dungeon together and escape before your torch burns out.

name: Whisper Network
description: Pass coded messages to your allies while sniffing out the rival spy ring.

name: Sky Ferry
description: Build airship routes between floating islands to deliver passengers and cargo.

name: The Alchemist's Cellar
description: Deduce which unlabeled ingredients brew gold and which brew disaster.

name: Signal Lost
description: Guide a drifting station crew home using only fragments of a shared code.

name: Gemcutter's Guild
description: Cut, polish, and set gems to build the most prestigious workshop in the guild.

name: Harbor & Hearth
description: Send villagers to the docks, fields, and markets to grow a seaside town.

name: Caravan Kings
description: Haggle, ally, and betray your way to control of the desert trade routes.

name: Moonbase Delta
description: Keep a failing lunar base alive through cascading system failures.

name: Ironroot
description: Four asymmetric factions struggle for control of an ancient forest kingdom.
